highlights.summary: 2+ years of self-driven and hands-on experience designing relational schemas, writing T-SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, migrations, and ensuring data integrity on Microsoft SQL Server.
Building structured operational and analytical reports using Crystal Reports and SQL aggregations to turn raw business records into clear, verifiable outputs.
Developing multi-company ERP modules, tenant isolation middleware, and SQL-backed operational portals using C# (.NET) and Python (FastAPI).
Applying CompTIA A+ certified methodology to hardware troubleshooting, operating system maintenance, ODBC driver configuration, and technical support.
